intro.title: Worlds, scenes and stories through painting
intro.quote: I create visual stories through painting, imagination and everyday objects. Each piece is a world of its own.
intro.bio: Sergi Tugas is an independent visual artist based in Barcelona. His paintings move between surrealism and conceptual art: dreamlike scenes, everyday objects and unexpected characters that tell small stories. Through them he seeks to capture raw emotions and true feelings.

artMail.title: Collectible art, by post
artMail.lead: A small envelope from Sergi’s artistic universe: an illustrated card, stickers, a short story and a collector detail, gathered around one collection at a time.
artMail.body: The club is planned as a monthly subscription, with single collections, gifts and special editions too. Details and pricing will be announced at launch.

annual.title: One original, once a year
annual.body: An initiative around a single original painting each year. How it will work is still being defined, and it will be announced here first.
